### What’s So Good About Friday?
Author: Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-apr-6-11536454.html
Passage: Romans 5:8
Points:
- The cross serves as permanent proof of God's unconditional love regardless of life's circumstances.
- Christ's death removed the veil of separation, giving sinners direct access to God's presence.
- The suffering of Good Friday was necessary to prepare the way for the victory of Easter.
- Salvation invites believers to trade their sinfulness for Christ's abundant, eternal life.

### Good Friday for Bad People
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/good-friday-for-bad-people
Passage: Romans 5:6-10
Points:
- Christ did not die for the worthy, but gave His life when we were completely weak and helpless.
- God demonstrated His love by sacrificing His Son while we were still active sinners.
- Even while we lived in open hostility toward God, Christ reconciled us through His death.
- Understanding the grim reality of our sin magnifies the beauty and power of the cross.
